headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Driven by Foreign Inflows, Lower Crude Oil Prices, and Sector Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows boosting investor sentiment across Indian markets.
Lower crude oil prices providing support to key market sectors.
Early trade momentum led by financial, banking, and auto stocks.
Positive sector rotation boosting overall market buying.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,300 points while Nifty jumped above the 25,375 level.
CLSA hiked the target price for HAL, labeling it as the cheapest pure-play defence stock.
Indian equity benchmarks closed higher after registering gains of nearly 1% in preceding trade.
Foreign fund optimism continues to drive buying interest across key heavyweights.
summary:
Indian stock markets surged as Sensex jumped over 1,300 points and Nifty crossed 25,375.
The market rally was driven by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and strong buying in banking and financial stocks.
Defence major HAL gained focus after CLSA hiked its target price citing its sector-leading position.
